name: jobwebghana-mcp
description: Jobweb Ghana (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: WordPress post-type feed of job_listing posts (RSS 2.0, 10 per page). WordPress feeds take the site search as s and page with paged (https://wordpress.org/documentation/article/wordpress-feeds/); ?feed=job_feed answers 404 on this site. location and limit are not sent. title is 'Role at Employer'; description is the full post (content:encoded, HTML) and the WordPress post id is raw['post-id']. id is the posting permalink.
